blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — After helping secure the historic Bangsamoro Parliamentary elections last month, troops of the Army’s 27th Infantry Battalion (27IB) have finally returned home. Maj. Gen. Alvin Luzon, 10th Infantry Division commander, alongside Brig. Gen. Christopher Diaz of the 1003rd Infantry Brigade, led the welcome ceremony for the returning officers and enlisted personnel on October 7 at Sitio Pag-asa, Barangay Malabog in Paquibato District, Davao City. During the deployment, the battalion was sent to the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) to ensure the safety of the September 14 polls.
